blocking_issues: apps/mobile/src/analysis/runJournalSchema.ts:94-104 (new table `analysis_reservation_refusal`, written by apps/mobile/src/analysis/partialOutcome.ts:135 saveReservationRefusal) breaks local account-deletion purge for every owner who has ever received a partial. The table has a non-deferred `FOREIGN KEY (owner_key, operation_id) REFERENCES analysis_run_journal(owner_key, operation_id)` with no ON DELETE action, the production DB runs with `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` (apps/mobile/src/data/db.ts:286), and the table is NOT in OWNER_SCOPED_TABLES (apps/mobile/src/data/repository.ts:104-114). purgeOwnerData() therefore fails at repository.ts:145 (`DELETE FROM analysis_run_journal WHERE owner_key = ?`) with `FOREIGN KEY constraint failed` (SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY, errcode 787) and rolls back the WHOLE owner purge — shots, captures, analysis records, journal and refusal rows all survive on the device after the server confirms account deletion; authStore.ts:1870-1878 retries LOCAL_PURGE_ATTEMPTS times (deterministic failure) and settles localPurge='failed'. VERIFIED (reviewer probe, not committed): runPartial() from the candidate's own suite, then purgeOwnerData(db, owner) → Error 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed', journalAfter=1, refusalAfter=1; log https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/34fa7d0b-27ac-4e2e-94f4-f4af27a8dcdd/probe-purge-fk.log, probe source https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/92363bbb-552e-4d21-bdfa-9a07d11858e1/probe-purge.test.tsx.txt (local artifacts/review-w01-05/). Existing accountDeletion.test.ts uses a mocked db so it cannot catch this. Violates the purge contract (repository.ts:133-137) and owner/cross-account isolation. Fixable inside write_paths (mobile-data group is not held): e.g. declare the FK `ON DELETE CASCADE` (or drop the FK and bind by identity checks, or store the refusal metadata in the existing local_analysis_record row) so `DELETE FROM analysis_run_journal WHERE owner_key=?` removes the owner's refusal rows; add a regression test in w01PartialOutcome.test.tsx that runs a partial and then purgeOwnerData() against the real migrated SQLite harness and asserts zero owner rows in analysis_reservation_refusal and analysis_run_journal.
